hero.label: A little place for you
hero.title:
I made this place
just for you.
hero.description:
Not because I have too many things to say.
There are simply a few things I want you to know.

intro.title:
Some people
appear so ordinarily.
intro.p1: And somehow, without realizing it, they become a part of the things we think about every day.
intro.p2: That's what you became to me.
intro.p3: There didn't have to be a perfect moment or a perfect story. Somehow, after you came into my life, ordinary days became a little more meaningful.

her.title:
There are so many things
I love about you.
her.item1: I love the way you care about the people around you, even when nobody asks you to.
her.item2: I love the way you keep trying for the things you truly care about.
her.item3: I love the way you smile and somehow make everything around you feel a little lighter.
her.item4: And I love all those little things about you that you probably don't even notice.

quote.text: I don't need a perfect story. I just need our story to have you in it.
quote.author: Me

littleThings.title:
I remember
the little things.
littleThings.description: Some moments may seem too small to remember, but somehow, I still do.
littleThings.item1: The times we talked until we completely lost track of time.
littleThings.item2: The moments when you laughed at something so simple.
littleThings.item3: The conversations that still make me smile whenever I think about them.
littleThings.item4: The moments that seemed ordinary, but became memorable simply because you were there.

ordinaryDays.title:
I love
ordinary days.
ordinaryDays.p1: They don't have to be a perfect date.
ordinaryDays.p2: We don't have to go somewhere far away.
ordinaryDays.p3: Sometimes, all I need is to talk to you, listen to you tell me about your day, or simply know that you're doing okay.
ordinaryDays.p4: Sometimes, those little things are enough to make my day better.

thankYou.title:
There are a few things
I want to thank you for.
thankYou.item1: Thank you for walking into my life.
thankYou.item2: Thank you for being patient with someone who sometimes doesn't know what to say.
thankYou.item3: Thank you for all the little happiness you bring into my days.
thankYou.item4: And thank you for showing me what it feels like to have someone to love.

message.title:
I don't know
how far we'll go.
message.p1: I don't want to make promises about some perfect future.
message.p2: I only know that if there are happy days ahead, I want to laugh with you. And if there are difficult ones, I still want to be there beside you.
message.p3: And if I could choose again, I would still choose to walk toward you.

future.title:
If someday
we look back...
future.p1: I hope we'll remember these days and smile together.
future.p2: Maybe we'll change. Maybe life will take us through many different things.
future.p3: But I hope that among all those changes, we'll still remember why we chose each other in the first place.
future.p4: And we'll still want to spend one more day together.

promise.title:
I won't promise
that everything will be perfect.
promise.p1: I know there will be days when we don't understand each other.
promise.p2: There will be moments when we're tired, moments when we're upset, and moments when we don't know what to say.
promise.p3: But I want to learn how to listen to you instead of always trying to be right.
promise.p4: I want to learn how to understand you instead of trying to guess what you're thinking.
promise.p5: And I want us to face difficult things together instead of giving up when things stop being easy.

oneThing.title:
If I could only say
one thing...
oneThing.text: I want you to know how deeply I appreciate the fact that you came into my life.
oneThing.description:
Not because you made my life perfect.
But because having you in my life made me want to become a better version of myself.

quoteTwo.text: Maybe the most beautiful thing isn't finding someone perfect, but finding someone who makes you want to grow together.
quoteTwo.author: Me

ending.label: To the person I love
ending.title:
Thank you
for being here.
ending.description:
Out of all the people in this world,
I'm lucky that my story happens to have you in it.
